companyFieldUpdates.description: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One) is an availability-based DBFM concession covering six public schools in Prince George's County, Maryland through Prince George's County Education & Community Partners, LLC. The ProjectCo reached financial close on December 18, 2020 with Fengate-controlled entities holding 75% and Gilbane Development holding 25%. Five middle schools opened in August 2023 and Colin L. Powell K-8 Academy opened in November 2023; lifecycle and facilities-management services continue under a term ending June 30, 2053. BBGI acquired 100% from the Fengate and Gilbane vehicles in February 2026 and remains the current owner; BCI's ownership of BBGI is upstream and is not added as a separate ProjectCo owner. Phase Two is a distinct project. No later sale, concession termination or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
